purpose.architectural_focus: Proof-of-work, fixed supply, transparency, reliability in one service

consensus.consensus_characteristics: Security through computational effort; strong censorship resistance; limited throughput; high energy cost

incentives.economic_principle: Scarce block space priced by fees. Issuance dominates early, fees later

tokenomics.native_coin: Yes: Secures base protocol, used for payments

network_effects.architectural_mechanism: Peer-to-peer payments; each user enlarges the transaction web; liquidity and connectivity deepen with user base

purpose.architectural_focus: Smart contracts, composability, dApps, stablecoins, tokenized assets

consensus.consensus_characteristics: Consensus integrates block creation with resource pricing and contract execution; optimizes scalability, efficiency, and diversity of applications

incentives.primary_incentives: Inherits: block rewards, transaction fees → generalized as gas; Extends: Staking rewards; role-specific fees (oracles, relayers)
incentives.economic_principle: Gas fees scale with resource use and demand. Incentives balance diverse actors while preventing congestion

tokenomics.native_coin: Yes: pays gas fees, anchors consensus and scarcity
tokenomics.tokens: Yes: Issued via smart contracts (ERC-20, ERC-721, etc.) for DeFi, governance, NFTs

network_effects.architectural_mechanism: Smart contracts and composability (DeFi, non-fungible tokens (NFTs), Layer-2 protocols (L2s)) create subgroup effects and developer–user feedback loops; EIP-1559 ties usage to token scarcity via fee burns

consensus.examples: Bittensor, Polkadot, Cosmos, Internet computer, Avalanche
consensus.dominant_mechanisms: Base-layer PoS or PoA; task-specific consensus (e.g., proof-of-intelligence in Bittensor)
consensus.consensus_characteristics: Layered design: Global ledger secured by PoS or PoA; specialised markets apply domain-specific validation; balances general security with task-level logic

incentives.primary_incentives: Inherits: block rewards, gas, staking; Extends: Task-specific rewards in service markets
incentives.economic_principle: Market-level fees reward verifiable outputs. Requires alignment between base-layer security and market-level incentives

tokenomics.native_coin: Yes: Secures base layer and coordinates cross-service activity
tokenomics.tokens: Yes: Service- or subnet-specific tokens within ecosystem
tokenomics.examples: Polkadot (DOT + parachain tokens), Cosmos (ATOM + zone tokens), Bittensor (TAO + subnet credits)

network_effects.architectural_mechanism: Coalition-forming design; subnets/parachains/zones enable interoperable clusters and subgroup dynamics by construction
